decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the extension would not result in harm to the appearance of the property or the wider area and would not cause harm to neighbours' living conditions in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to existing house
